thread.title: Special Participation B: ChatGPT-5.1 Pro on HW4 Coding
thread.content: <document version="2.0"><paragraph>I used ChatGPT 5 - Pro on HW 4(all coding parts). </paragraph><file url="https://static.us.edusercontent.com/files/9Mp7aH5A7iGzLXJgf1HWRMLl" filename="Code explanation breakdown.pdf"/><paragraph>Summary: It one-shot all the coding, and when I asked it to explain all topics, explained them quite clearly to me. The largest issue again was reasoning time, taking 40+ minutes to generate a response.</paragraph><paragraph/></document>
thread.document:
I used ChatGPT 5 - Pro on HW 4(all coding parts). 

Summary: It one-shot all the coding, and when I asked it to explain all topics, explained them quite clearly to me. The largest issue again was reasoning time, taking 40+ minutes to generate a response.
